sources.entry: VSCodium - VSCodium is a community-driven, freely-licensed binary distribution of Microsoft's VS Code with all telemetry removed.

summary.one_liner: VSCodium is a community-maintained repository of build scripts that produce MIT-licensed, telemetry-free binaries of Microsoft's Visual Studio Code.
summary.what_it_does: The repository contains scripts and CI workflows that clone Microsoft's vscode repository, apply a community-driven default configuration with telemetry and Microsoft-specific endpoints removed, and publish the resulting binaries to GitHub releases. The README states it is not a fork but a build-script repository. Binaries are offered for macOS (zip, dmg), Windows (x64 and arm64), and several Linux formats and architectures (deb, rpm, AppImage, snap, tar.gz, Flatpak). Install options are listed for Homebrew, WinGet, Chocolatey, Scoop, snap, Arch AUR packages, and Flatpak. Extensions come from open-vsx.org rather than the Visual Studio Marketplace. Builds run daily and exit early when Microsoft has no new release.
use_cases: install a telemetry-free version of VS Code
install VS Code on macOS via Homebrew
install a code editor on Linux via snap or Flatpak
install a code editor on Windows via WinGet or Chocolatey
use an open-source VS Code build with open-vsx extensions
stack: Visual Studio Code (Microsoft vscode repo, built from source)
notable: Builds telemetry-free, MIT-licensed VS Code binaries from Microsoft's source with a community default configuration
Broad platform coverage including macOS arm64, Windows arm64, and Linux riscv64, loong64, and ppc64le tarballs
Uses open-vsx.org for extensions because of Visual Studio Marketplace terms
Many package-manager install routes, including Arch AUR packages and Flatpak
caveats: Some VS Code extensions have licenses restricting them to official Microsoft builds and do not work with VSCodium, per the README
Windows 32-bit is listed only as previously supported, with the latest available version v1.83.1.23285
Minimum OS versions are constrained by Electron's platform prerequisites
keywords: remove microsoft telemetry from vs code
